hints.title: String Valuation Rule
hints.text: If a string contains digits only, its value is its base-10 integer representation; otherwise its value is its string length.

hints.title: Digit Identification
hints.text: Check whether all characters in string s are decimal digits.

hints.title: Maximum Value Search
hints.text: Evaluate the value of every string in the array and return the highest value encountered.
